blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The witness presented by Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team in her impeachment trial admitted that preparing a financial report on questionable transactions in just two weeks, as the prosecution’s witness did, is possible but difficult. The admission came during Thursday’s resumption of the trial, when defense counsel Mark Vinluan asked former Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) investigator Reinel dela Fuente whether an “extensive financial investigation” could be completed in just two weeks. Before posing the question, Vinluan had asked dela Fuente about his credentials and work at the agency. “I would just like to ask very quickly, can […]...
